summary.text: Loving Consolation is a refinement path killer move Fang Yuan renames and uses to steady incomplete Immortal Gu with words of consolation.

claims.text: The white crane-like heaven form cries out in front of Fang Yuan. His fingers spread like blooming flowers as he activates a refinement path killer move. Traces of green and fragrant wind move around the white crane like chains coiling on its body, stabilizing its form. Heaven form was declining, but after this method its collapse slows.

The method began as a killer move from an information path Gu Immortal. Because it was special and had refinement path effect, Lang Ya land spirit kept a copy. After Fang Yuan’s modification, he abandons the original name and calls it loving consolation. It seems like information path but is actually a refinement path method, and after returning to its roots the effect is greatly elevated. The move lets a Gu Immortal use words of consolation on an incomplete Immortal Gu to affect the refinement process. If those words reach an incomplete Immortal Gu that is about to break apart, its condition can stop worsening, and it can even recover and succeed in refinement.

The effect is continuous. Each sentence has little effect, and only an accumulation of non-stop speech produces an evident result. If an accident happens and the move is not used in time, or if its effect cannot catch the speed of deterioration, the refinement cannot be salvaged. It can only be used on an incomplete Immortal Gu, so the refinement must reach a stage where that form exists. Many Gu recipes refine Immortal Gu immediately with no intermediate incomplete Immortal Gu, and the move cannot be used in those cases.

Heaven form was originally intact, but with the fusion of black heaven and white heaven it suffered major injuries and can be treated as an incomplete Immortal Gu. The basis is that Fang Yuan is a refinement path venerable with the attainment and methods to treat the rank nine killer move heaven form as a Gu worm undergoing refinement.
